region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis patient-add front end HCP1BA01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCAPDB01 (which inserts the PATIENT row and returns the new id) and, when that returned CA-RETURN-CODE 0, LINKs HCAPDB02 (which inserts the USER row), then RETURNs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). commarea.CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC: 1234567890Ada       Lovelace            1985-12-101 Analytical Way    London              AB1 2CD   07700900001         ada@example.org                                   ALOVELACE

scenarios.why: front end LINKs HCAPDB01 (PATIENT row, new id returned) then HCAPDB02 (USER row for that id): CA-RETURN-CODE '00'
